name: Held Shot
description: Hold the shot. Each turn held makes the next Longshot or Killing Silence hit 60% harder, up to three turns.

name: Longshot
description: Releases the charge into one target. Heavy on its own; ruinous after three turns of holding.

name: Recon
description: Calls the field. Everything on it is target-locked for two turns, so nobody in the party can miss.

name: Patience
description: Wait. Guard until your next turn and put six into the party's Tempo while you do.

name: Killing Silence
description: Spends every turn of Held Shot, up to three, on one shot nothing gets a say in: it cannot miss, and armor, shields, guard and immunity are not consulted.
